run_segment_th_stdin: run the segment_th.py module to tokenize Thai text from stdin into space-separated words
run_segment_th_pipeline: run the segment_th.py module in a pipeline to tokenize multiple Thai sentences from a file
run_segment_th_batch: run the segment_th.py module to batch-tokenize Thai text lines via stdin redirection
run_segment_th_word_split: run the segment_th.py module to split Thai text into individual words using pythainlp word_tokenize
run_segment_th_cleanup: run the segment_th.py module to strip newlines and tokenize Thai input lines from stdin
